comment: Params 0 to 3 report the recognised chord back to the panel display and param 6 carries the Sharps&Flats menu setting; none of them has a widget. The gate test at composites/Visualizer.h:137 compares the channel index with > rather than >=, so when the gate cable has fewer channels than the pitch cable the first channel past the end of the gate cable is read as 0V rather than being excluded outright; either way it is treated as a low gate. The module runs its chord recognition once every 32 samples unless the Root or Valid output is patched, in which case it runs every sample (composites/Visualizer.h:202-207).
